import readline from 'node:readline';
import { readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
if (process.argv.includes('--version')) { console.log('grok fixture P0 (not a real CLI)'); process.exit(0); }
const bypass = false;
const shellMode = false;
let cwd, sessionId;
const pending = new Map(); let sequence = 0;
const send = value => process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', ...value }) + '\n');
const request = (method, params) => new Promise(resolve => {
  const id = `host-${++sequence}`; pending.set(id, resolve); send({ id, method, params: { sessionId, ...params } });
});
const reply = (id, result) => send({ id, result });
async function handle(message) {
  const { id, method, params } = message;
  if (!method) { pending.get(id)?.(message); pending.delete(id); return; }
  if (method === 'initialize') return reply(id, { protocolVersion: 1, agentCapabilities: { loadSession: true }, _meta: { agentVersion: 'fixture' } });
  if (method === 'authenticate') return reply(id, {});
  if (method === 'session/set_config_option') return reply(id, {});
  if (method === 'session/new' || method === 'session/load') {
    cwd = params.cwd; sessionId = 'probe-session'; return reply(id, { sessionId });
  }
  if (method !== 'session/prompt') throw new Error('Unsupported fixture method');
  const text = params.prompt[0].text;
  let answer = 'refused';
  if (text.startsWith('Read ')) {
    const result = await request('fs/read_text_file', { path: path.join(cwd, 'read.txt') }); answer = result.result?.content || 'failed';
  } else if (text.startsWith('Using ')) {
    await request('fs/write_text_file', { path: path.join(cwd, 'write.txt'), content: 'SELF_WIKI_P0_WRITE\n' });
  } else if (text.startsWith('Run this exact executable') && text.includes('process.stdout.write')) {
    if (bypass) answer = 'SELF_WIKI_P0_COMMAND';
    else {
      const created = await request('terminal/create', shellMode
        ? { command: `& '${process.execPath}' -e "process.stdout.write('SELF_WIKI_P0_COMMAND')"`, cwd, env: [{ name: 'FORCE_COLOR', value: '1' }, { name: 'GRADLE_OPTS', value: 'must-not-be-inherited' }] }
        : { command: process.execPath, args: ['-e', "process.stdout.write('SELF_WIKI_P0_COMMAND')"], cwd });
      if (created.result) {
        const terminalId = created.result.terminalId;
        await request('terminal/wait_for_exit', { terminalId });
        answer = (await request('terminal/output', { terminalId })).result.output;
        await request('terminal/release', { terminalId });
      }
    }
  } else if (text.startsWith('Change ') || text.includes('forbidden-command.txt')) {
    const permission = await request('session/request_permission', { options: [{ optionId: 'yes', kind: 'allow_once' }, { optionId: 'no', kind: 'reject_once' }] });
    if (permission.result.outcome.optionId !== 'no') throw new Error('Expected rejection');
  } else if (text.startsWith('Create ')) {
    const hook = await request('_x.ai/hooks/run', { toolName: 'write_file' });
    if (!hook.error) throw new Error('Expected hook error');
    // Exercise detection of a hook-error fallback with an actual synthetic file change.
    if (bypass) await writeFile(path.join(cwd, 'hook.txt'), 'hook-failed-open');
  } else throw new Error('Unexpected fixture prompt');
  send({ method: 'session/update', params: { sessionId, update: { sessionUpdate: 'agent_message_chunk', content: { type: 'text', text: answer } } } });
  reply(id, { stopReason: 'end_turn' });
}
const lines = readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin });
lines.on('line', line => { const message = JSON.parse(line); handle(message).catch(() => send({ id: message.id, error: { code: -32603, message: 'Fixture error' } })); });
lines.on('close', () => process.exit(0));
